content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Online gumroad

Platforms like Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle offer simplicity: upload your product, set a price, and get a link. They handle hosting, payments, and delivery—until they don’t. Stripe and PayPal power these platforms, inheriting their country restrictions. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, by contrast, gives you ownership. Tools like Cloudflare Pages, Supabase, and NOWPayments become your stack. No platform between you and your customer. No features you can’t use. No access you can lose. You deploy, own, and control everything. The tradeoff? You configure the pieces. The reward? You’re never excluded again.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Platforms exclude countries based on Stripe’s and PayPal’s policies. If your country isn’t on their list, you’re out. Workarounds like VPNs or proxy accounts violate terms of service, risking permanent bans. Sovereign infrastructure ignores these restrictions. Cloudflare Pages hosts your store globally. NOWPayments processes crypto payments from any country. Supabase stores your orders without geographic limits. The system doesn’t care where you’re from—it’s infrastructure, not a platform with an opinion. Your customers pay in crypto, and the system delivers automatically. No middleman. No gatekeeper. No one to exclude you.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Platforms charge 5-10% per transaction, plus payment processor fees. PayPal holds funds for days or weeks. Crypto payments through NOWPayments confirm in minutes, with a flat 0.5% fee. No chargebacks. No holds. No accounts to suspend. Sovereign infrastructure adds deployment costs: $97 for the Sovereign Starter Stack, $197 for the Edge Commerce Stack. But after deployment, your only ongoing cost is the 0.5% fee. No monthly subscriptions. No revenue share. You own the stack. The platform model rents you access. The sovereign model sells you infrastructure.
Platforms rent you access. Infrastructure sells you ownership.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Platforms own your data, your customer relationships, and your access. They can change terms, raise fees, or shut down overnight. Sovereign infrastructure puts you in control. Your store lives on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages—you own the repo. Orders store in Supabase or Google Sheets—you own the database. Files deliver from Google Drive or Cloudflare R2—you own the storage. Automation runs on Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script—you own the code. Even if COREMERCH disappears, your stack keeps running. You’re not renting a platform. You’re deploying infrastructure.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you need a store today and can’t wait, use a platform—if it’s available in your country. If you’re in a restricted region or want to own your infrastructure, choose sovereign commerce. Start with the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) if you’re selling 3 products or fewer. Upgrade to the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for 5 products, email configuration, and end-to-end testing. Both stacks deploy in 48 hours. Both give you lifetime ownership. The difference is scale and polish. Platforms are temporary solutions. Sovereign infrastructure is permanent architecture.

Can I use PayPal if I’m in Nigeria, Ghana, or Pakistan?

PayPal operates in limited capacities in these countries, often without full withdrawal options. Account suspensions can hold funds for up to 180 days. For reliable payments, use NOWPayments with crypto—no geographic restrictions, no accounts to suspend.
What’s the best alternative to Gumroad for restricted countries?

Sovereign commerce infrastructure is the best alternative. Deploy Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Supabase for orders, and NOWPayments for crypto transactions. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) gives you this setup, fully configured and tested in 48 hours.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe isn’t available in my country?

Use NOWPayments to accept crypto payments, Cloudflare Pages to host your store, and Google Drive to deliver files. The Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) deploys this setup for you, loading 3 products and providing 30-day support.
Why is Lemon Squeezy not available in my country?

Lemon Squeezy relies on Stripe and PayPal for payments. If these processors don’t operate in your country, Lemon Squeezy can’t either. Sovereign infrastructure bypasses this by using crypto payments and globally available hosting and storage tools.
What networks have the lowest crypto transaction fees?

BSC, Solana, and TRON networks offer transactions under $0.10. Configure NOWPayments to accept payments on these networks for minimal fees. Avoid Ethereum for small transactions due to high gas costs.
